_comment: The team's taste as visual dials: the target when the user does not choose at the direction gate. Each value cites the approved rule in team/taste.md it comes from. Change it only together with taste.md.

sources.colour: Prefer: bold flat colour with clear roles (Maxima, Scotch, Playfolly; owner 2026-10-30)
sources.typeRatio: Owner's favourites: Swehl and Future x6.3, Maxima x24 (style cards, 2026-11-01)
sources.imagery: Prefer (2026-11-02, supersedes the 2026-10-30 default): photographs as the key visual, flat drawings from the subject layered over or beside them, drawings alone only when no honest photograph exists (owner; batch-004 Tennis, batch-002 Future)
sources.motion: Prefer: smooth choreographed scroll storytelling with a reduced-motion version (Scotch, Maxima; owner 2026-10-30)
sources.priceNearAction: Always: price near the main action (Future; owner + jury 2026-10-30)
sources.fonts: Always: two type families, one text face 80-95% + one display face (9 of 9 library sites; owner 2026-11-02)
